pool_config.pool_brief: Build a data analytics system using array higher-order functions. Your solution must use: map to transform data, filter with at least one compound condition, reduce to compute a total or build an accumulator, find or findIndex to locate a single item, some or every for boolean checks, and at least one method chain combining 2+ HOFs. All variables must use const or let.

projects.title: Opay Transaction Analytics
projects.scenario: Build a transaction analytics system for an Opay merchant. Process the provided transaction dataset to generate insights, summaries, and reports using array higher-order functions.
requirements: Use map to create an array of transaction summary strings: 'TXN-001: ₦5000 (transfer) — completed'
Use filter to get only completed transactions, then filter again with a compound condition: completed AND amount > 3000
Use reduce to calculate the total revenue from all completed transactions
Use find to locate the transaction with id 'TXN-004'; log its details
Use some to check if any transaction is 'failed'; use every to check if all transactions have an amount > 0
Chain filter (completed only) → map (extract amounts) → reduce (sum) in one expression; log the result

projects.title: Bamboo Investment Portfolio Analyser
projects.scenario: Build a portfolio analysis system for a Bamboo investor. Process the provided stock holdings dataset to generate performance reports and insights using array higher-order functions.
requirements: Use map to create an array of holding labels: 'AAPL — 10 shares @ $150.00 = $1500.00'
Use filter to get only profitable holdings (currentPrice > buyPrice), then filter with compound condition: profitable AND quantity >= 5
Use reduce to calculate total portfolio value (sum of quantity * currentPrice for all holdings)
Use find to locate the holding with symbol 'GOOGL'; log its details
Use some to check if any holding has lost more than 20% of its value; use every to check if all holdings have quantity > 0
Chain filter (profitable) → map (compute gain per holding) → reduce (total gains) in one expression; log the result

projects.title: Chipper Cash Transfer Report

requirements: Use map to create an array of transfer labels: 'To: Kenya — $200 (completed)'
Use filter to get only completed transfers, then compound filter: completed AND amount >= 100
Use reduce to calculate total amount sent across all completed transfers
Use find to locate the transfer with id 'TRF-005'; log its details
Use some to check if any transfer was 'rejected'; use every to check if all transfers have a valid recipient (non-empty string)
Chain filter (completed) → map (extract amounts) → reduce (average amount) in one expression; log the average

projects.title: Korapay Merchant Settlement Report
projects.scenario: Build a settlement report system for a Korapay merchant. Process the provided payout dataset to generate financial summaries and analytics using array higher-order functions.
requirements: Use map to create an array of payout labels: 'PAY-001: ₦45,000 to GTBank (settled)'
Use filter to get only settled payouts, then compound filter: settled AND amount >= 50000
Use reduce to calculate total settled amount across all payouts
Use find to locate the payout with id 'PAY-004'; log its details
Use some to check if any payout has status 'failed'; use every to check if all payouts have an accountNumber property with length > 0
Chain filter (settled) → map (amounts) → reduce (average payout) in one expression; log the average

descriptors.full: map returns correctly transformed array; filter uses correct condition including at least one compound condition (&&); both return new arrays without mutating the original
descriptors.partial: map or filter used but one has an incorrect condition or mutates the original array
descriptors.none: map and filter absent or both producing incorrect results

descriptors.full: reduce correctly accumulates a total with proper initial value; find locates the correct item and handles the case where it might not exist
descriptors.partial: reduce works but missing initial value, or find used but result not logged
descriptors.none: reduce and find both absent or non-functional

descriptors.full: some and every used with correct boolean conditions; at least one chain of 2+ HOFs (e.g., filter→map→reduce) written as one expression with correct results
descriptors.partial: some/every present but chain missing, or chain present but broken at one step
descriptors.none: No some/every and no method chaining

descriptors.full: const/let used correctly; arrow functions used in callbacks; output is clear and labelled; no var; no mutation of original data
descriptors.partial: Minor issues — occasional unclear output or function keyword instead of arrow
descriptors.none: var used, data mutated, or output is unreadable
